name: Enki
title: Flood Father
summary: Bring the waters of Ekur and Mend your allies Spirit restoring them from death.
lore: Lord of the Sweet Waters, Enki is creator of life in Ekur. Stubborn and curmudgeonly, he has isolated himself since the Shattering, which he views as the other gods’ failure. Opposed to both the current Order and Destiny’s view of the future, he is content to see Chaos run rampant until a replacement of which he personally approves should appear.
archetype_description: Increase outgoing healing and turn meter boosts by 1% for each piece of cloth armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: At the start of the turn, place [Mend] on all allies for 1 turn.
Also remove Disable from all allies.
Also revive 1 defeated ally with 100% HP and 100% Turn Meter.

awakening_bonuses.description: Also remove Disable from all allies.
